source_reproduction.source: Wylęgała and Uhl 2026, Acta Astronautica, DOI 10.1016/j.actaastro.2026.07.006
source_reproduction.replication_policy: First recover exact sample batch, fill fraction, drum geometry, surface finish and image-analysis settings from the paper and Zenodo files. Reproduce their statistical/replicate structure if the raw data permit; otherwise preregister at least three independent repeats per selected cell. Do not call a partial factor match a full reproduction.

extension_screen.replication_policy: One screening run per cell only if sample state can be reset and instrument repeatability is established. Select confirmatory cells using a preregistered sequential-design rule and use at least three independent repeats. Hold out at least one complete material batch and one wall/geometry combination from model calibration.

derived_quantities.froude_number: Fr=omega^2*R/g; use measured angular velocity, drum inner radius and local acceleration.
derived_quantities.cohesion_to_weight_ratio: Cw=F_cohesive/(m_particle*g), measured or bounded independently; not inferred solely from angle of repose.
derived_quantities.particle_to_drum_ratio: d50/R using characterized particle size and measured drum radius.
derived_quantities.wall_roughness_ratio: Ra/d50 using measured wall roughness and batch-specific d50.

claim_ceiling: No physical test has been run by this design file. All extension factor levels are proposed screening choices. Returned Chang'e-6 CE60100 sample data are a source-specific micro-sample benchmark, not a bulk material supply for this matrix.

batch_transfer_screen.partition_policy: Characterize each physical lot independently. Train/calibrate only on calibration_batch; use validation_batch only for model selection; blind_test_batch is held by an independent custodian until executable, source revision, config, parameters, seed and predictions are frozen. Do not split repeated samples from one batch across partitions.
batch_transfer_screen.replication_policy: Proposed minimum three independently conditioned repetitions per sentinel cell after apparatus repeatability is demonstrated. This is a plan, not a performed test.
batch_transfer_screen.claim_ceiling: Batch labels are roles, not actual named materials. No batch has been sourced, tested, or qualified.
